# Utah Mountain Luxury Management

This is a private operations dashboard for short-term rentals (Ranch House, Lindon House, River House) and a construction project. Live: https://wilhite-portfolio.pages.dev

## For browser agents (Grok / Cursor)

1. Read `/api/agent/map` (JSON) or this file.
2. Prefer **hash routes** or `window.UML.navigate(...)` over clicking the top nav. Overlay widgets can intercept clicks.
3. After login, `document.documentElement.dataset.umlTab` is the current screen.
4. Primary controls use `data-bot="..."` attributes.

### Hash routes

- `#/overview` — portfolio. The page says how many door codes open tomorrow, with no names and no codes. The turnover list names checkout time, when the next stay starts, when that door code opens, how many guests the next booking names, including children when the note names them, whether the next stay named an arrival time, whether this checkout named a departure time, whether a 2:00 PM leave is open for that checkout, whether the next stay can arrive at 1:00 PM, whether that stay can request the hot tub or a grocery drop, and the guest's quiet hours. Names and the code stay off the list. Download occupancy lists taken nights and leaves names off the file. The list does not change a booking.
- `#/market` — top 10 comps, a 90-day rate band, the same open arrivals as the booking page, the lengths the first arrival can quote, and the add-ons that arrival can request, with no prices. The unsent daily text names those lengths and add-ons when the calendar is live, where the booking calendar asks for a longer start than the rate card, and which other houses will quote that arrival. That comparison has no prices. When reservations have loaded, the text says which stays name a party size and which name children. When the calendar is live, it also names the checkouts in the next two weeks and whether a 2:00 PM leave or a 1:00 PM arrival is open. When preference cards have loaded, it says which name an arrival time and which checkouts name a departure time. Names stay off those lines. Sample comps until live comps are connected. A calendar block stays closed and is not counted as a booked night. The 30, 60, and 90 night share leaves those blocks out of the sellable nights. It does not change Airbnb or VRBO rates.
- `#/agents` — nightly brief from the calendar and the shadow clock, including where Ranch and River stays still on the books were booked, keeping the source name when it is not Airbnb or VRBO, the next open stretch, the next open arrival, the lengths that arrival can quote, the add-ons that arrival can request, where the booking calendar asks for a longer start than the rate card, how many door codes open tomorrow, and what the guest was asked to do before checkout. Codes stay off the brief. The brief names the stay agreement and does not sign it. It also says which other houses will quote the next open arrival, with no prices. A blocked night stays off the stretch and the arrival. Checkout lines name 11:00 AM and how many guests the next booking names. Names stay off. It does not claim jobs.
- `#/report` — P&L report
- `#/owner` — Todd’s Ranch and River statement. Read only. Download saves that same statement. A count of stays still on the books says where they were booked, keeps the source name when it is not Airbnb or VRBO, and names the next open stretch. The next open arrival lists the lengths it can quote and the add-ons it can request, with no prices. It also names where the booking calendar asks for a longer start, with no prices, and that list is not in the spreadsheet. The next checkout names when the following stay starts, when that door code opens, whether the preference card names a departure time, and whether a 2:00 PM leave is open for that checkout. The code stays off, and that line is not in the spreadsheet. Stays that begin in the next 90 days are listed with the night count, whether the booking says how many guests, including children when the note names them, whether the preference card names an arrival time, whether a 1:00 PM arrival is open, and whether that stay can request the hot tub or a grocery drop. Names and prices stay off, and that list is not in the spreadsheet. A blocked night stays off that stretch. Names stay off, and the count is not in the spreadsheet. Lindon and household bills are not on it.
- `#/clean` — turnovers for the next two weeks, with the address, a map link, parking, house notes, before-you-go drive notes, the guest's quiet hours and no-smoking rule, and the checkout steps the guest was asked to do. Those rules and steps are not the cleaner checklist. The work order names when the next stay starts, when that door code opens, how many guests are checking out, how many guests the next booking names, including children when the note names them, whether that next stay named an arrival time, whether this checkout named a departure time, whether a 2:00 PM leave is open for that checkout, whether the next stay can arrive at 1:00 PM, and whether that stay can request the hot tub or a grocery drop. Names and the code stay off the paper.
- `#/report/documents` — e-sign / document vault
- `#/guests` — each stay says which add-ons that stay can request, how many guests the booking names, including children when the note names them, whether the preference card names an arrival time, whether a 2:00 PM leave is open for that checkout, whether a 1:00 PM arrival is open, and when the door code opens on the guest phone. The party line does not repeat a name. The add-on line has no price. The code stays off this list. This page does not send the request.
- `#/ranch` `#/lindon`
- `#/river` — River rental. `#/river/launch` is the November 1 opening page. `#/river/build` is build costs.
- `/book` — month calendar of nightly prices, with the shortest stay that can start each open night when that stay is longer than one night. A gap shorter than that minimum is marked too short and cannot be chosen as check-in. It can still be a checkout morning. The page also shows the published house (including the hot tub, septic, and river notes, the checkout steps, the published nearby places, and to call 911 first), a map link, a printable house guide that includes the direct price, the party, the arrival time, and the departure time, and the day the door code opens on the guest phone. An earlier arrival, a later checkout, the Ranch hot tub, and a River grocery drop can be added to the request when the nights allow. Checking one does not charge a card or send the request. Open arrivals fill the dates. Other houses open for those dates are listed. A house that will not quote them says why, with no price. A longer stay can be opened. A party that does not fit stays closed. A party larger than the River House can quote Ranch and River together. Each house keeps an adult. That quote does not hold either house. Nothing is sent. The page offers the shortest stay a check-in can start and the lengths that check-in can quote, up to 28 nights. A guest count has to fit. Two or more guests see how the stay total splits. The page address reopens that quote, including the arrival time and the add-ons that are checked. The guest can name an arrival from 4:00 PM through after 9:00 PM. That time would be in the request note. Arrive at 1:00 PM replaces it. Choosing a time does not send the request. Children count toward the overnight guests. A party of only children stays closed. That count is on the quote link and would be in the request note. Nothing is sent. When the direct stay is below the Airbnb guest total, the page says so. Booked nights are refused. A calendar block is marked Closed on the month. A stay is marked Booked. The count of nights ahead leaves a calendar block out of the booked nights. A sent request includes the house rules that were read. Checking the box does not send one. The page names the stay agreement for that house and does not create it. It does not charge a card or hold the dates.
- `/stay/:token` — guest trip sheet with check-in, checkout, the address, how to arrive, the arrival time from the preference card when one was named, the departure time when one was named, whether a 1:00 PM arrival is a request or that night is already taken, and whether a 2:00 PM leave is a request or that morning is already taken, where to park, the house rules, nearby places grouped like the booking page, the house notes, the checkout steps, and to call 911 first. The screen and the paper show the same lines. A door-code or Wi-Fi line is left off. The paper copy leaves the door code and Wi-Fi on the phone. Before checkout, each stay-agreement topic can be marked read on that phone. That does not sign it, and nothing is sent. It does not change the reservation.
- `#/ours` — Brandon & Stephanie household / furnishings (photo, paste text, or manual; off rental P&L)

### JavaScript bridge

```
UML.navigate("construction")
UML.navigate("report", "documents")
UML.setMonth("2026-08")
UML.state()
UML.help()
```

### Login

POST `/api/auth/login` with `{ "password": "..." }` (cookie). Form: `[data-bot="login-password"]` and `[data-bot="login-submit"]`.

Muse and Amanda have full control with `Authorization: Bearer` `MUSE_BOT_SECRET` or `AMANDA_BOT_SECRET`.
OpenAPI: `/api/muse/openapi.json` and `/api/amanda/openapi.json`.
Tools: `GET/POST /api/muse/tools` or `/api/amanda/tools`. Use tool `dashboard_request` for any other `/api` route.
Signed-in browser: `/api/muse/enter?token=` or `/api/amanda/enter?token=`.

### Do not

- Put construction partner bills on ranch/lindon/river. Partner spend is construction only.
- Treat Lindon as 50/50 with Todd; Lindon is Brandon’s rental P&L.
- Use Firecrawl unless the user asked.

### Useful APIs (cookie auth)

- GET `/api/portfolio/metrics?month=YYYY-MM`
- GET `/api/expenses`
- POST `/api/expenses` — construction: `propertyId: "construction"`, `paidBy: "brandon"|"todd"`, `stage`
- POST `/api/expenses` — Brandon & Stephanie household: `propertyId: "household"`, `paidBy: "brandon"`, `category` Furnishings/Decor/Supplies/Other
- POST `/api/agent/chat` — rental co-host tools
- POST `/api/agent/construction/chat` — construction manager
- GET `/api/construction/project`
- GET `/api/esign/templates`
- POST `/api/esign/parse-invoice` — import a contractor invoice or email onto a lien waiver (`type`: text / image / gmail / gmail-search)
- GET `/api/surveys` — upcoming stays + preference surveys
- POST `/api/surveys/send` — `{ reservationId? , confirmationCode?, channel: "email"|"sms"|"none" }` mints `/stay/:token`. `none` copies a link for Airbnb paste (does not email/SMS the guest).
- GET/POST `/api/stay-preferences/:token` — public guest survey. River uses the short VIP flow and asks for an arrival time. Choosing a time does not send the form.
